channel.title: Robotics Directory - Robotic Arms
channel.description: Browse 293 robotic arms in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Enactic OpenArm 2.0
item.description: OpenArm 2.0 is Enactic’s open-source seven-DOF-per-arm platform for physical-AI research, teleoperation and reproducible evaluation. The company dates its launch to May 2026. A compact camera-equipped gripper and changed J5 bracket distinguish it from 1.0, while the upgrade guide retains arm structure, motors and electronics. Reach and mass are per arm; payload ratings include the end effector and depend on short specified tests. Hardware and software use different licenses.

item.title: Dobot PULSA 7
item.description: High-speed industrial collaborative arm launched at the 2026 Shanghai Industrial Expo. It reaches J6 joint speeds of up to 790°/s with ±0.02 mm repeatability, is IP67-rated and has internal cable routing.

item.title: Dobot PULSA 12
item.description: 12 kg version of Dobot's high-speed PULSA industrial cobot, with ±0.03 mm repeatability, IP67 protection and upright, inverted or side mounting.

item.title: Kinova KIMA
item.description: Medical robotic arm built for clinical use rather than adapted from an industrial robot. Kinova targets endoscopy, bronchoscopy and surgical interventions with it. Kinova launched it in 2026 for its 20th anniversary. It sits in the 3 kg payload class and has a frame under 13 kg. Every joint has redundant torque sensors. It has no separate control box: control runs over EtherCAT through a control library. Its software is IEC 62304 Class C.

item.title: Annin Robotics AR4 MK4
item.description: Open-source 6-axis desktop arm kit with 600mm reach for makers.

item.title: The Robot Studio SO-101
item.description: Low-cost open-source 6-DoF arm for Hugging Face LeRobot AI training.

item.title: Neuromeka OPTi3
item.description: OPTi3 is the named 3 kg member of Neuromeka’s welding-oriented OPTi family. The exact catalog table gives six revolute axes, 940 mm maximum reach, 630 mm workspace, 0.1 mm repeatability, 1 m/s tool speed and IP54. Its mass is printed 11 kg (TBD), so this field remains preliminary rather than a finalized measured weight. The chronology explicitly names the OPTi3 launch in October 2025. A modified joint/link layout supports welding positioning; torches, vision, fixtures and a complete welding cell are not automatically included or independently performance-tested.

item.title: Enactic OpenArm 1.0
item.description: OpenArm 1.0 is the historical Enactic dual-arm research platform, also called OpenArm 01 in the company portfolio and launched in July 2025. Its archived documentation is no longer actively maintained. A linkage-driven parallel gripper distinguishes it from the compact camera-equipped 2.0 gripper. Payload includes tooling and is limited by the stated posture and test duration; current vendor revision labels do not prove identical hardware.

item.title: Franka Robotics Franka Research 3 Duo
item.description: Franka Research 3 Duo is a dual-arm research setup built from FR3 arms. Franka Robotics showed it as a prototype at Automatica 2025, alongside a mobile version (Mobile FR3 Duo).

item.title: BrainCo Revo 2
item.description: Bionic dexterous hand for humanoid robots. It has 6 coreless motors, 6 active joints and 11 DoF, multimodal tactile sensing, 50 N grip force, 0.1 mm precision and a 64 V wide input range. Basic and Haptic versions are sold.

item.title: Comau MyCo-3-0.59
item.description: Smallest arm in Comau's six-model MyCo cobot family, with 3 kg payload, 590 mm reach and ±0.02 mm repeatability.

item.title: Comau MyCo-3.5-0.95
item.description: MyCo family cobot with 3.5 kg payload, 950 mm reach and ±0.02 mm repeatability.

item.title: Comau MyCo-5-0.80
item.description: MyCo family cobot with 5 kg payload, 800 mm reach and ±0.03 mm repeatability.

item.title: Comau MyCo-8-1.30
item.description: MyCo family cobot with 8 kg payload, 1300 mm reach and ±0.03 mm repeatability.

item.title: Comau MyCo-10-1.00
item.description: MyCo family cobot with 10 kg payload, 1000 mm reach and ±0.03 mm repeatability.

item.title: Comau MyCo-15-1.30
item.description: Largest arm in the MyCo cobot family, with 15 kg payload, 1300 mm reach and ±0.05 mm repeatability.

item.title: Waveshare RoArm-M2-S
item.description: ESP32 desktop 4-DoF arm with omnidirectional base and WiFi control.

item.title: SenseRobot SenseRobot Chess
item.description: AI chess-playing robot arm with 26-level adaptive opponent for home

item.title: Shadow Robot Company DEX-EE
item.description: DEX-EE is a rugged three-fingered robot hand with 12 DOF that Shadow Robot built with Google DeepMind for real-world machine-learning research. Shadow unveiled it on 9 May 2024 as 'the world's most robust dexterous robot hand'. A chiral variant, DEX-EE Chiral, came later.

item.title: Dobot CR5A
item.description: 6-axis collaborative robot from DOBOT's industrial CRA series, with a 5 kg payload, 900 mm reach and 0.02 mm repeatability. It is used for assembly, dispensing and material handling. The CRA series was unveiled at the Automate show in 2023.

item.title: Pickle Robot Pickle Unload Robot
item.description: Autonomous truck and trailer unloading robot: a six-axis KUKA arm with a suction gripper on a mobile base with an onboard conveyor, driven by the Dill Autonomy Engine. Unloads 400-1,500 cases per hour and is deployed at UPS.

item.title: Mecademic MCS500
item.description: Compact micro-SCARA robot with its controller in the base and an optional smart vacuum and I/O module. It has 5 µm repeatability, a 225 mm reach and a 500 g rated payload (1 kg maximum under certain conditions). It can be mounted on a table or hung overhead. Pre-orders opened in 2023 after an early-access programme.

item.title: SunFounder PiArm
item.description: 4-DoF Raspberry Pi arm with joystick control and Blockly programming.

item.title: Kinova Link 6
item.description: Kinova calls Link 6 Canada's first industrial collaborative robot. Its controller has room for an optional GPU. It offers visual programming, manual guidance, a multi-purpose wrist with a coloured status ring, and native support for several industrial grippers. It launched in March 2022 and was available at launch.

item.title: Franka Robotics Franka Research 3
item.description: Franka Research 3 (FR3) is a 7-DOF force-sensitive arm for robotics and AI research. It succeeds the Panda and is made by Munich-based Franka Robotics, part of Agile Robots since 2023. It has a 3 kg payload, 855 mm reach, torque sensors in all seven joints and better than ±0.1 mm repeatability.

item.title: Nala Robotics Nala Chef
item.description: Multi-cuisine robotic chef using machine learning to replicate recipes precisely.

item.title: Exotec Skypicker
item.description: Skypicker is Exotec’s articulated automatic picking module introduced in January 2021 for integration with the Skypod warehouse system. A camera and visualization algorithms support object handling,and an order mover enables four orders to be prepared simultaneously. The launch describes rigid objects below 2 kg with at least 2 by 2 cm of graspable surface and 2 m/s object-transfer speed; later issuer materials round the limit to up to 2 kg. Up to 600 items per hour is a task-specific picking claim,distinct from Skypod Workstation container throughput.

item.title: RightHand Robotics RightPick 3
item.description: Turnkey autonomous piece-picking system: a hybrid suction-and-finger gripper on UR5e/UR10e arms with ML vision. Picks up to 1,200 units per hour.

item.title: Neura Robotics MAiRA
item.description: MAiRA is a 7-DOF 'cognitive' collaborative arm launched in 2021, with built-in 3D vision, voice recognition and force-torque sensing. It comes as MAiRA S (15-18 kg payload, 1100 mm reach, 51 kg), MAiRA M (12-14 kg, 1400 mm, 53 kg) and MAiRA L (9-11 kg, 1600 mm, 56 kg).

item.title: Comau Racer-5 COBOT
item.description: Six-axis, 5 kg cobot (Racer-5-0.80 COBOT) with 809 mm reach and 0.03 mm repeatability. It runs at industrial speed and drops to a 500 mm/s collaborative speed when LiDAR detects a person.

item.title: Neura Robotics LARA
item.description: LARA (Lightweight Agile Robotic Assistant) is NEURA's 6-axis collaborative arm family, launched in November 2020. It runs from LARA 3 (3 kg payload, 590 mm reach) to LARA 30L (30 kg, 1800 mm). The maker states ±0.02 mm precision and 24/7 operation.

item.title: Dobot Magician Lite
item.description: Lightweight K12 4-axis arm with Magic Box controller and collision detection.

item.title: Rotrics DexArm
item.description: All-in-one desktop arm with swappable toolheads for printing and engraving.

item.title: Rozum Robotics Rozum Cafe
item.description: Robotic barista arm brewing over 400 specialty coffees per day.

item.title: PAZZI Pizzaiolo Robot
item.description: Autonomous robotic pizzeria making, baking and slicing pizzas without staff.

item.title: Niska Robotic Gelato Bar
item.description: Six-axis robotic kiosk serving customizable gelato and ice cream.

item.title: Neuromeka Indy12
item.description: Indy12 is the named 12 kg member of Neuromeka’s original Indy collaborative-arm family. The manufacturer history explicitly records its release in 2019; Indy7 production starting in July 2018 is a different milestone. The current shared page also names V3, Pro and K variants, while the retrieved V20251205 catalog labels detailed numerical tables V3 or Pro. Those reach, mass, IP, speed and axis values are not backfilled into this base identity. Direct teaching, impedance control, sensorless collision detection and tablet programming are manufacturer family features, not independently certified safety or a specific bundled gripper.

item.title: Flexiv Rizon 4
item.description: 7-axis force-controlled adaptive collaborative robot from Shanghai-based Flexiv for contact-rich tasks such as precision assembly and polishing. Specs: 4 kg payload, 876 mm reach, ±0.05 mm repeatability, IP65. The Rizon robot was introduced in 2019.

item.title: WLkata Mirobot
item.description: 6-axis mini industrial arm for education with Blockly and Python.

item.title: Elite Robots EC63
item.description: Compact 6-axis collaborative robot from Suzhou-based Elite Robots' first EC series, with a 3 kg payload, 624 mm working radius, ±0.03 mm repeatability and 150 W typical power. The EC series (EC63/EC66/EC612) was ready for mass production in August 2018.

item.title: Elite Robots EC66
item.description: Mid-size 6-axis collaborative robot with a 6 kg payload, 914 mm working radius, ±0.03 mm repeatability and 250 W typical power. Its alpha version was built in 2017, and it entered mass production with the EC series in August 2018.

item.title: Elite Robots EC612
item.description: Large 6-axis collaborative robot in Elite Robots' EC series, with a 12 kg payload, 1,304 mm working radius, ±0.03 mm repeatability and 500 W power. It was ready for mass production in August 2018.

item.title: Kassow Robots KR1205
item.description: The KR1205 is a 7-axis collaborative arm from Kassow Robots with a 5 kg payload and 1200 mm reach. It supports ROS/ROS2 and Profinet.

item.title: Kassow Robots KR1805
item.description: The KR1805 is Kassow Robots' long-reach 7-axis collaborative arm, with a 5 kg payload and 1800 mm reach.

item.title: Cafe X Technologies Cafe X Robotic Barista
item.description: Kiosk robotic arm barista crafting espresso drinks in seconds.
